memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: status – persistent heartburn after meals, occasional regurgitation; plan – start pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, domperidone 10 mg BD before meals, antacid gel SOS; advise small frequent meals, avoid lying down within 2 h of food, elevate head of bed; weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (above male cut‑off 90 cm).
- Lifestyle: status – sedentary accountant, minimal exercise; plan – brisk walk 30 min daily, reduce caffeine and spicy food.
Due: HbA1c not indicated (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast; Domperidone 10 mg BD before meals; Antacid gel SOS.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: H. pylori stool antigen: Negative (<0.9 IU/mL). Reference range: Negative <0.9, Positive ≥0.9.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I still have occasional burning after dinner, but less frequent. No vomiting or difficulty swallowing.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: status – heartburn frequency down to 2‑3 days/week, mild intensity; plan – continue pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, stop domperidone, keep antacid gel SOS; reinforce meal timing, avoid late‑night snacks.
- Weight: 77 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off).
Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-08-05 at 10:30 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: status – occasional heartburn after heavy meals, otherwise asymptomatic; plan – continue pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, consider taper after 3 months if symptoms remain absent; continue lifestyle measures.
- Weight: 76 kg, waist 88 cm (below cut‑off).
Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Last week I woke up with a sour taste and mild throat burning; took antacid gel and it improved.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: status – nocturnal symptoms returning 2‑3 nights/week, mild‑moderate; plan – continue pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, add evening dose of pantoprazole 20 mg after dinner for 2 weeks, review; reinforce head‑of‑bed elevation.
- Weight: 76 kg, waist 89 cm.
Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Dr Sumanth Reddy, Gastroenterology, Vikram Hospital, for upper GI endoscopy to assess refractory reflux symptoms.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Upper GI endoscopy: Los Angeles grade A erosive esophagitis in distal esophagus, no Barrett’s epithelium, H. pylori negative on biopsy.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Gastroenterologist confirms mild erosive esophagitis, recommends continue PPI twice daily for 8 weeks then taper to once daily, lifestyle modification, repeat symptoms review in 3 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: status – endoscopy shows grade A erosions; plan – pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast + 20 mg after dinner for 8 weeks, then taper to 40 mg OD; continue antacid gel SOS; weight 75 kg, waist 87 cm.
Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: status – heartburn reduced to 1‑2 days/week after taper start; plan – continue pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, stop evening dose, monitor; lifestyle advice reinforced.
- Weight: 75 kg, waist 86 cm.
Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: status – asymptomatic on pantoprazole 40 mg OD; plan – attempt taper to pantoprazole 20 mg OD for 4 weeks, then assess; if symptoms recur, restart 40 mg OD.
- Weight: 74 kg, waist 84 cm (below cut‑off).
Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: status – symptoms well controlled on pantoprazole 20 mg OD; plan – continue current dose, review in 3 months.
- Weight: 73 kg, waist 82 cm (at female cut‑off, male below).
Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: status – no heartburn or regurgitation on pantoprazole 20 mg OD; plan – maintain dose, annual lifestyle review.
- Weight: 73 kg, waist 81 cm.
Due: HbA1c not indicated.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed: moved from 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-11 at 09:00 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for routine follow‑up.
